content:
Context: 7. Central Administrative Tribunal

The application should contain the prayer of the applicant specifying sought for, explaining the grounds for such relief and the legal provision, if any, relied upon. The application should be based upon a single cause of action and may seek one or more reliefs, provided they are consequential to one another. Interim relief, if any, prayed for, pending final decision  
relief on the application, should be incorporated in the application itself.
